name: Sea Gate
hero_subtitle: The historic ocean entrance of the Portuguese fortress.

overview.title: Gateway between citadel and ocean
overview.p1: The Sea Gate was the main access to the fortress on the ocean side. It still marks the transition between the fishing port, the beach and the interior of the Portuguese City.
overview.p2: Passing through it is the natural start or end of a walk along the ramparts. The stonework and proportions recall 16th-century military architecture.
overview.p3: Free access. Ideal as a meeting point before visiting the cistern or the walls.

q1.question: How much time for Sea Gate?
q1.answer: 30 to 60 minutes is usually enough for a good visit.

q2.question: Is there an entry fee?
q2.answer: Many outdoor areas are free; the cistern has a ticket. Check on site.

q3.question: Can I visit with children?
q3.answer: Yes, most sites are suitable for families with basic supervision.

q4.question: Is it open every day?
q4.answer: Outdoor sites are generally accessible daily; indoor sites may close one day a week.

q5.question: Do I need a guide?
q5.answer: Not required, but a local guide enriches the history of the Portuguese City.
